basis: Issue #2767; audit #2745 section 12; pack sections 5, 7 and 8; native scope #2431; provenance #2764; benchmarks #2765. No engineering equation, coefficient or acceptance limit is introduced.

duties: Confirm the screening design basis and intended use.
Record primary and alternate independent-review assignments with a durable revision-bound reference.
Retain the draft status until independent review and finding dispositions are recorded.
Review the exact source, tests, pack and index revision independently of implementation.
Check sources, applicability, C01-C07 results and unresolved qualification limits.
Record the review scope, findings and clearance recommendation against that revision.
Provide independent review when the primary reviewer is unavailable or has a conflict.
Record activation and the same revision-bound evidence required of the primary reviewer.

lessons.finding: Analytical screening regression does not establish native installation qualification.
lessons.prevention: Keep offline output checks separate from independent pack review and native installation clearance.

lessons.finding: Formula invariants alone can pass incorrect physics.
lessons.prevention: Use independent arithmetic anchors, equilibrium closure and fail-before-output assertions.

C02.assertion: An unknown diameter key raises ValueError before any output file is written; input provenance is not established.

C03.assertion: J-lay geometry, strain and derived tension match the independent screening-basis arithmetic anchors.

C04.assertion: Residual outputs match the independent screening-basis arithmetic anchors; a tight reel core fails the screen.

C05.assertion: A feasible higher-tension case reduces strain and meets the existing screening-basis closure criterion.

C06.assertion: Both method summaries match router results and contain no native-model or time-history outputs.

C07.assertion: Both summaries reject non-finite tokens, match returned fields and retain matching input/output digests on reread; this is test evidence, not an issued provenance appendix.

pack_review.scope: Review of the analytical knowledge pack only; not installation clearance.

required_evidence.revision: Exact source, tests, pack and index revision reviewed; changed evidence requires renewed review.
required_evidence.assignments: Durable maintainer confirmation of primary and alternate review responsibilities and independence.
required_evidence.independent_review: Revision-bound independent review reference with scope, findings and recommendation.
required_evidence.check_results: C01-C07 test node IDs, command, revision, outcomes, log reference and input/output digests for the reviewed cases; failures and unexecuted checks remain explicit.
required_evidence.disposition: Maintainer disposition of each finding and unresolved qualification issue with the allowed use and exclusions.

required_evidence.authorized_scope: Separately authorized installation scope, sourced inputs and case matrix.
required_evidence.solver_evidence: Native model and results at a recorded solver version, case identity and retained input/output digests, including applicable dynamics.
required_evidence.criteria: Edition-qualified criteria and independent benchmarks with versioned tolerances, applicability and documented comparisons.
required_evidence.independent_review: Independent review and maintainer disposition of the installation evidence and issued analysis.
